rows.en: ＊Sakaki＊＠１５９＿０２１Good morning.￥Mind if I come in for a moment?
＊Sakaki＊＠１５９＿０２２I'll get right to the point...＝＠１５９＿０２３Lately, you've been neglecting￥your Intellect training.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５９＿０２４At this rate, you'll fall too￥far behind the other candidates.＝＠１５９＿０２５I've opened up the Archives￥system for you, so let's do￥some extra training together.
